system.description:
• Frame (1st): Hit Die d8.
  • You are trained in medium armour, shields and martial weapons, use Charisma for weapon attack and damage rolls, and use the Knight Base to Hit track.
  • Your spell slots come from the Spell Slot Progression row two below your Warlock level, never lower than the 1st-level row, and you never gain slots above 5th level.
  • Until 17th level you call a Tier 4 servant only through Bound Servant.
  • Patron Surge uses no slot and works as written.
  • You take feats as any Warlock (the Full caster ladder, Arcane & Devout list).
  • Hex Brand (1st): once per encounter, as part of a hit, brand the creature, at no cost.
  • For the encounter your hits on it deal +1d6 necrotic damage and are critical hits on a 19 or 20, and when it drops to 0 HP you regain HP equal to your Warlock level.
  • The extra die is not a rider: it adds to every hit against the branded foe, alongside Eldritch Strike or Life Drinker.
  • Eldritch Strike (1st): once per round, when you hit with a weapon, spend 1 Patron Favour to release your signature blast through the blade.
  • The target takes the blast's damage with no save, and saves against its Mark as normal.
  • A Burst is centred on the target and doesn't affect you; a Lance runs on from the target, away from you; a Chain leaps from the target; Long can't be used.
  • Other creatures save as normal.
  • Free invocations (1st): any two Blade invocations.
  • Extra Attack (7th): when you use your action to attack, make one more weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • 9th: Hex Brand works twice an encounter, and once per encounter Eldritch Strike costs no Patron Favour.
  • Hungering Brand (15th): when a branded foe drops, the Brand jumps at once to another foe within 30ft.
  • Pact spells: Compelled Duel, Blur, Haste (yourself only), Stoneskin, Ethereal Jaunt.
